lesson: The system is consistently entering trades on low-confidence signals (avg <35%) during liquidity sweeps that fail to trigger genuine trend reversals. By attempting to counter-trend or scalp weak momentum, the strategy is getting chopped out by the prevailing bearish markdown phase.
adjustment: Implement a strict minimum confidence threshold of 60% and filter out all counter-trend entries until the price successfully reclaims the 4h EMA50.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less on ADAUSDT without a confirmed Wyckoff accumulation structure.
